workflow_runs.display_title: #1342 WP1174-WINDOWS-BACKEND r3 (bậc r1c): seed riêng ACL + BootId Windows đứng riêng, chưa nối dây

head_commit.message:
#1342 WP1174-WINDOWS-BACKEND r3 (bac r1c): seed rieng ACL + BootId Windows dung rieng

Them, DUNG RIENG (khong ham hien co nao goi toi, chua noi vao runtime):
- _1174_win_api_bao_mat: bind them tren advapi32 (GetSecurityInfo,
  ConvertSecurityDescriptorToStringSecurityDescriptorW, OpenProcessToken,
  GetTokenInformation, ConvertSidToStringSidW) va kernel32 (LocalFree,
  GetCurrentProcess).
- _1174_win_seed_acl: ham THUAN chinh sach SDDL OWNER|DACL cua seed
  (owner = nguoi dung, DACL bao ve, chi ACE ALLOW khong co cho nguoi
  dung va SYSTEM).
- _1174_win_seed: ban Windows cua _1174_seed, chi doc; tren MOT handle
  do dinh danh, NumberOfLinks va SDDL truoc va sau khi doc, hai lan do
  phai bang nhau; tham so kiem thu between.
- _1174_win_boot_id: doc BootId (REG_DWORD) tu registry bang winreg,
  fail-closed, khong fallback.

Test: ca thuan wp1342_pure_seed_acl_bang (29 dong bang) va
wp1342_pure_seed_boot_refuse; tam ca native wp1342_native_seed_* /
wp1342_native_boot_* (Linux: BO QUA, khong tinh dat). Khong doi MUTANTS,
WP1174_REQUIRED, WP1174_BOTH; khong sua than dinh nghia hien co nao.

Chua do: cac ca native tren Windows (phien dieu phoi do tren Desktop/VM).

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_015GtxrbrSybU6erWQLbGk9Z
